aboutText: Based in Kealba, All Round Concrete Cutting has been providing professional concrete cutting, drilling, and demolition services to the Greater Melbourne area for many years. We use only the highest quality German drills to ensure fast, efficient, and precise work on every job. Whether you need a small cut or a large demolition project, our experienced team delivers exceptional results. Contact us for a free, no-obligation quote today.
servicesText: From concrete cutting to demolition, All Round Concrete Cutting offers a comprehensive range of services in Kealba. We handle both commercial and domestic projects with the same level of professionalism and care. Our team is equipped with the latest tools to deliver fast and efficient results.

services.title: Concrete Cutting
services.desc: We provide precise concrete cutting services for floors, walls, and slabs using advanced diamond blades for clean edges.

services.title: Concrete Drilling
services.desc: Our core drilling services are perfect for creating openings for plumbing, electrical, or HVAC installations.

services.title: Demolition Work
services.desc: We handle all types of concrete demolition, from small sections to complete structures, safely and efficiently.

services.title: Saw Cutting
services.desc: For larger concrete projects, our saw cutting services ensure accurate and quick removal of concrete sections.

services.title: Excavation
services.desc: We offer excavation services to prepare sites for new concrete installations or other construction needs.

services.title: Removal and Disposal
services.desc: All Round Concrete Cutting manages the complete removal and responsible disposal of concrete debris after the job.
